crossRefs.note: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

translations.web: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.
translations.bsb: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
translations.kjv: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
translations.asv: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.
